extraction.Name: Thomas Wright
extraction.Refused/Protested: I think the patent should not have been issued to me without my asking for it as I have no education and would therefore not be in a position to take care of it. This is the reason I sent it back to the office
extraction.Buyer: not stated (reference to Smith, Colome, Youngquist, or Martin)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the taxes were going to take it and I would receive letters telling me that the land was about to be sold for taxes so I thought I had better get a little something out of it
extraction.Occupation/Income: I work a little here and there and stay with my relatives part of the time as I have no home
extraction.NOTES: At time of sale had a wife and one child who have since died; was working for the government as policeman at the time the patent was issued; states he has no education; interpreter Carlos Gallineaux present; notary Ths. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32; did not receive a car, horses, or anything else from Smith, Colome, Youngquist, or Martin, nor were any promised
